chapters.title: The ascension
chapters.summary: The risen Jesus promises the Holy Spirit: you will be my witnesses in Jerusalem and to the ends of the earth. He is taken up into heaven, and Matthias replaces Judas.

chapters.title: Pentecost
chapters.summary: The Holy Spirit comes like wind and fire, and the disciples speak in other languages. Peter preaches, three thousand are baptized, and the believers share everything.

chapters.title: Healing at the Beautiful Gate
chapters.summary: Peter tells a lame beggar, "Silver and gold have I none; in the name of Jesus, walk." The man leaps up, and Peter calls the crowd to repent.

chapters.title: Boldness before the council
chapters.summary: Peter and John are arrested and tell the council there is salvation in no other name. Released, the church prays for boldness and shares everything in common.

chapters.title: Ananias and Sapphira
chapters.summary: A couple lie about their gift and fall dead. Many are healed. The apostles are jailed, freed by an angel, and tell the council: we must obey God rather than men.

chapters.title: Seven chosen to serve
chapters.summary: Seven men full of the Spirit are chosen to care for widows so the apostles can focus on prayer and the word. Stephen is seized and falsely accused.

chapters.title: Stephen martyred
chapters.summary: Stephen retells Israel's history and accuses the council of resisting the Spirit. As they stone him, he sees Jesus standing at God's right hand and prays for his killers. Saul approves.

chapters.title: The gospel spreads
chapters.summary: Persecution scatters the church. Philip preaches in Samaria and then explains Isaiah to an Ethiopian official, who is baptized and goes on his way rejoicing.

chapters.title: Saul's conversion
chapters.summary: On the road to Damascus a light blinds Saul and Jesus asks, why do you persecute me? Ananias restores his sight, and Saul preaches Jesus. Peter raises Dorcas.

chapters.title: Peter and Cornelius
chapters.summary: A vision teaches Peter not to call anyone unclean. He preaches to the Roman centurion Cornelius, and the Holy Spirit falls on the Gentiles. God shows no partiality.

chapters.title: Christians at Antioch
chapters.summary: Peter explains that God has given repentance to the Gentiles. The church at Antioch grows with Barnabas and Saul, and the disciples are first called Christians.

chapters.title: Peter freed from prison
chapters.summary: Herod kills James and jails Peter. The church prays earnestly, and an angel leads Peter out. Herod is struck down, and the word of God grows.

chapters.title: The first journey
chapters.summary: The Spirit sends Barnabas and Saul, now Paul, out from Antioch. In Pisidian Antioch Paul preaches forgiveness through Jesus, and many Gentiles believe.

chapters.title: Iconium and Lystra
chapters.summary: Paul and Barnabas are mistaken for gods in Lystra, then Paul is stoned and left for dead. They strengthen the new churches: through many troubles we enter the kingdom.

chapters.title: The council at Jerusalem
chapters.summary: The apostles and elders decide that Gentile believers need not be circumcised, for we are saved through grace. Paul and Barnabas part ways.

chapters.title: Philippi
chapters.summary: Timothy joins Paul. In Philippi Lydia believes. Paul and Silas are beaten and jailed, sing at midnight, and an earthquake frees them. The jailer asks, what must I do to be saved?

chapters.title: Thessalonica, Berea and Athens
chapters.summary: The Bereans search the Scriptures daily. In Athens Paul speaks of the unknown God, in whom we live and move and have our being.

chapters.title: Corinth
chapters.summary: Paul works as a tentmaker with Priscilla and Aquila in Corinth for a year and a half. God tells him in a vision: do not be afraid; I am with you.

chapters.title: Ephesus
chapters.summary: Paul teaches in Ephesus for two years, and the word spreads through Asia. Magic books are burned, and silversmiths riot over the goddess Artemis.

chapters.title: Farewell to Ephesus
chapters.summary: Paul raises Eutychus after a long sermon, then says goodbye to the Ephesian elders: it is more blessed to give than to receive.

chapters.title: On to Jerusalem
chapters.summary: Paul is warned he will be bound in Jerusalem but is ready to die for Jesus. In the temple a mob seizes him and Roman soldiers take him away.

chapters.title: Paul's defense
chapters.summary: Paul tells the crowd how Jesus met him on the Damascus road. When he mentions the Gentiles they riot, and he claims his Roman citizenship.

chapters.title: Before the council
chapters.summary: Paul divides the council over the resurrection. The Lord stands by him at night: take courage. A plot to kill him is uncovered, and he is moved to Caesarea.

chapters.title: Before Felix
chapters.summary: Paul is accused before Governor Felix and testifies to his hope in the resurrection. Felix trembles but keeps him in custody for two years.

chapters.title: Appeal to Caesar
chapters.summary: Before the new governor Festus, Paul appeals to Caesar. King Agrippa asks to hear him.

chapters.title: Before Agrippa
chapters.summary: Paul tells King Agrippa his story and calling. Agrippa says, almost you persuade me to be a Christian.

chapters.title: Shipwreck
chapters.summary: Sailing to Rome, the ship is caught in a violent storm for many days. An angel assures Paul all will live, and everyone reaches land when the ship breaks up.

chapters.title: Rome at last
chapters.summary: On Malta Paul survives a snakebite and heals the sick. He reaches Rome and for two years welcomes all who come, preaching the kingdom of God boldly.
